items.name: .AspNetCore.Antiforgery.*
items.purpose: Protects demo forms and state-changing requests against cross-site request forgery. The suffix is generated by ASP.NET Core.
items.duration: Session. Your browser removes it when the browsing session ends.

items.name: stcm.consent.essential
items.purpose: Records that essential preference storage is enabled.
items.duration: No automatic expiry. Remains until you clear site data.

items.name: stcm.consent.analytics
items.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or rejected Google Analytics.
items.duration: No automatic expiry. Remains until you clear site data.

items.name: stcm.hasConsented
items.purpose: Remembers that you have made a cookie choice so the banner does not appear on every page.
items.duration: No automatic expiry. Remains until you clear site data.

items.name: demo_ga
items.purpose: Google Analytics uses this identifier to distinguish browsers when measuring visits. Set only after you accept analytics.
items.duration: Up to two years, refreshed on later visits. Your browser may apply a shorter limit.

items.name: demo_ga_*
items.purpose: Google Analytics uses this cookie to record session state. The suffix identifies the analytics property. Set only after you accept analytics.
items.duration: Up to two years, refreshed on later visits. Your browser may apply a shorter limit.
